_comment: Schmoose built-in IDP user file (copy to userdata.json next to the compose file).
Fields: login (username or email at the IDP login form), email (the account
mapping key — REQUIRED), password (INITIAL password in cleartext; it is
hashed automatically on the user's first login), optional claims dict —
if present it REPLACES the default token claims entirely (preferred_username,
email), so include everything you want the app to see (e.g. name, photoUrl,
a short-name claim). The file is re-read on every login: add or remove users
by editing it — no restart needed. Keep it private: chmod 600 userdata.json.
